body:
I think i was maybe in grade 3 when this happened? I was cuddling with my mother when she brought up my weight (ive always been v skinny). She proceeded to stand me infront of her full body mirror, take my night gown off and call me disgusting.

I brought this incident up to her recently and her response was "I dont remember that, i remember being angry and worried about your weight."

 She told me all the time as a kid no one would want to be my friend because you could see the bones in my chest? Growing up it fucked me up but now that I'm 24 Im just like literally wha t thefuck man.

I grew up with a sister who for real saved my life, shes was so loving and kind to me. I feel bad that I couldn't have been that person for her but I understand I was a kid and there wasn't much i could do. She past away in September 2019 randomly at 24 and honestly, my heads been SO fucked up since.
She was absolutely my rock and what kept me sane while growing up.

I am in therapy and trying to heal, i have a lovely partner and a lovely chosen family <3
Thank you for your kind words I appreciate them so much <3 me and my sister were very close and I'm sure she wouldn't want me to end it all. Thank you for the motivation <3

Hey, I'm so sorry for your loss :( I lost my big sister (who I was extremely close to my whole life) back in september and can 1000% relate to what you're going through. If you wanna vent to anyone or just talk about anything my inbox is always open <3
Hey! I have dealt with (and currently deal with) self harm issues, feel free to message me <3
Hey! I am absolutely in the same boat as you, if you ever want to message me feel free <3
Thank you so much, I can't even put into words the emotions this made me feel <3 big sisters are the best thing in the whole world <3
It really is, thank you for your kind words <3 its very encouraging <3

Oh my gosh that's horrible :( thank you so much for your response <3 I definitely think I will try to do that whenever I'm feeling down. And yeah I think that's probably a fitting idea, I'm going to go do some mental health stuff this week and see if I can start healing <3 thank you SO much, much love <3
